lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਿੰਦਹਿ ਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣਾ ਜੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: braham bi(n)dahi te braahamanaa je chalahi satigur bhaai ||
lines.translation: He alone knows God, and he alone is a Brahmin, who walks in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kai hiradai har vasai haumai rog gavaai ||
lines.translation: One whose heart is filled with the Lord, is freed of egotism and disease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਹਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun ravahi gun sa(n)grahahi jotee jot milaai ||
lines.translation: He chants the Lord's Praises, gathers virtue, and his light merges into the Light.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਿੰਦਹਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: is jug mahi virale braahaman braham bi(n)dahi chit laai ||
lines.translation: How rare are those Brahmins who, in this age, come to know God, by lovingly focusing their consciousness on Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਸੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jinh kau nadar kare har sachaa se naam rahe liv laai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace, remain lovingly attuned to the Name of the True Lord. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਤੀਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kee sev na keeteeaa sabad na lago bhaau ||
lines.translation: One who does not serve the True Guru, and who does not love the Word of the Shabad,

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਅਤਿ ਦੀਰਘੁ ਬਹੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai rog kamaavanaa at deeragh bahu suaau ||
lines.translation: earns the very painful disease of egotism; he is so very selfish.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manahath karam kamaavane phir phir jonee paai ||
lines.translation: Acting stubborn-mindedly, he is reincarnated over and over again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh janam saphal hai jis no aape lae milaai ||
lines.translation: The birth of the Gurmukh is fruitful and auspicious. The Lord unites him with Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak nadaree nadar kare taa naam dhan palai paai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, when the Merciful Lord grants His Mercy, one obtains the wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh vadiaaeeaa har naam vich har guramukh dhiaaeeai ||
lines.translation: All glorious greatness is in the Name of the Lord; as Gurmukh, meditate on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਸਾਈ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: j vasat ma(n)geeai saaee paaeeai je naam chit laaeeai ||
lines.translation: One obtains all that he asks for, if he keeps his consciousness focused on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਹਜ ਗਲ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਕੀਚੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਸਿ ਤਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: guhaj gal jee kee keechai satiguroo paas taa sarab sukh paaeeai ||
lines.translation: If he tells the secrets of his soul to the True Guru, then he finds absolute peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur pooraa har upades dei sabh bhukh lahi jaaeeai ||
lines.translation: When the Perfect Guru bestows the Lord's Teachings, then all hunger departs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jis poorab hovai likhiaa so har gun gaaeeai ||3||
lines.translation: One who is blessed with such pre-ordained destiny, sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur te khaalee ko nahee merai prabh mel milaae ||
lines.translation: No one goes away empty-handed from the True Guru; He unites me in Union with my God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਜੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਇਛੇ ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kaa darasan saphal hai jehaa ko ichhe tehaa phal paae ||
lines.translation: Fruitful is the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the True Guru; through it, one obtains whatever fruitful rewards he desires.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad a(n)mrit hai sabh trisanaa bhukh gavaae ||
lines.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is Ambrosial Nectar. It banishes all hunger and thirst.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਚੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ras pee sa(n)tokh hoaa sach vasiaa man aae ||
lines.translation: Drinking in the sublime essence of the Lord brings contentment; the True Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਵਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach dhiaai amaraa pad paaiaa anahad sabad vajaae ||
lines.translation: Meditating on the True Lord, the status of immortality is obtained; the Unstruck Word of the Shabad vibrates and resounds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੋ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sacho dah dis pasariaa gur kai sahaj subhaae ||
lines.translation: The True Lord is pervading in the ten directions; through the Guru, this is intuitively known.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਛਪਹਿ ਨ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੇ ਛਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jin a(n)dar sach hai se jan chhapahi na kisai de chhapaae ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those humble beings who have the Truth deep within, are never hidden, even if others try to hide them. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur sevaa te har paaeeai jaa kau nadar karei ||
lines.translation: Serving the Guru, one finds the Lord, when the Lord blesses him with His Glance of Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਸ ਤੇ ਦੇਵਤੇ ਭਏ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maanas te devate bhae sachee bhagat jis dei ||
lines.translation: Human beings become angels, when the Lord blesses them with true devotional worship.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਚੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai maar milaaian gur kai sabad suchei ||
lines.translation: Conquering egotism, they are blended with the Lord; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are purified.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sahaje mil rahe naam vadiaaee dei ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they remain merged with the Lord; they are blessed with the glorious greatness of the Naam. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਧਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur satigur vich naavai kee vadee vadiaaee har karatai aap vadhaaee ||
lines.translation: Within the Guru, the True Guru, is the glorious greatness of the Name. The Creator Lord Himself has magnified it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਕ ਸਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਵੇਖਿ ਵੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਨੑਿ ਓਨੑਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sevak sikh sabh vekh vekh jeevanhi onhaa a(n)dar hiradai bhaaee ||
lines.translation: All His servants and Sikhs live by gazing, gazing upon it. It is pleasing to their hearts deep within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਦੁਸਟ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵੇਖਿ ਨ ਸਕਨਿ ਓਨੑਾ ਪਰਾਇਆ ਭਲਾ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)dak dusat vadiaaee vekh na sakan onhaa paraaiaa bhalaa na sukhaaee ||
lines.translation: The slanderers and evil-doers cannot see this glorious greatness; they do not appreciate the goodness of others.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਝਖ ਮਾਰੀ ਜਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa hovai kis hee kee jhakh maaree jaa sache siu ban aaee ||
lines.translation: What can be achieved by anyone babbling? The Guru is in love with the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਗਲ ਕਰਤੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ਸਭ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਮਰੈ ਲੋਕਾਈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: j gal karate bhaavai saa nit nit chaRai savaaee sabh jhakh jhakh marai lokaaee ||4||
lines.translation: That which is pleasing to the Creator Lord, increases day by day, while all the people babble uselessly. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਏਹ ਆਸਾ ਦੂਜੇ ਭਾਵ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhrig eh aasaa dooje bhaav kee jo mohi maaiaa chit laae ||
lines.translation: Cursed are the hopes in the love of duality; they tie the consciousness to love and attachment to Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਲੑਰਿ ਤਿਆਗਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: har sukh palhr tiaagiaa naam visaar dukh paae ||
lines.translation: One who forsakes the peace of the Lord in exchange for straw, and forgets the Naam, suffers in pain.
